title: "metaphlan_species_exploration"
format: html

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(mgnet)
library(compositions)
```

```{r}
ibdm <- mgnet(
  
  rela = read_tsv("../../results/metaphlan/metaphlan_species_abundance_matrix.tsv",
                 show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>%
    as.matrix(),
  
  meta = read_tsv("../../data/metadata_ena_sra/processed/ibdmdb_metadata_runs_mgx.tsv",
                   show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(run_accession, host_subject_id, host_disease,
           host_sex, host_age, collection_date) %>%
    left_join(read_tsv("../../results/kneaddata_summary.tsv",
                       show_col_types = FALSE),
              by = "run_accession") %>%
    mutate(host_subject_id = as.factor(host_subject_id)) %>%
    arrange(run_accession) %>%
    column_to_rownames("run_accession"),
  
  taxa = read_tsv("../../results/metaphlan/metaphlan_species_taxonomy_matrix.tsv",
                   show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    column_to_rownames("species"))
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
meta(ibdm, "tbl") %>%
  mutate(sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
         host_subject_id = as.character(host_subject_id),
         sample_id = fct_reorder(sample_id, raw_pairs, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  rename(cleaned = clean_pairs,
         trimmed_removed = pairs_removed_by_trim,
         human_removed = pairs_removed_after_trim) %>%
  select(sample_id, host_subject_id, host_disease, host_sex,
    raw_pairs, cleaned, trimmed_removed, human_removed) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(cleaned, trimmed_removed, human_removed),
               names_to = "read_class", values_to = "read_pairs") %>%
  mutate(read_class = factor(read_class,
                             levels = c("human_removed", "trimmed_removed", "cleaned"),
                             labels = c("Human removed", "Removed by trimming", "Cleaned"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_id, y = read_pairs, fill = read_class)) +
  geom_col(width = .95) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Sample ID", y = "Raw read pairs", fill = "Read class") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
summary(pull_meta(ibdm, clean_pairs))
ibdm <- filter_meta(ibdm, clean_pairs >= 1e6) 
```


```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=3}
ibdm %>%
  meta("tbl") %>%
  group_by(host_subject_id) %>%
  mutate(mean_age = mean(host_age)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(host_subject_id = as.character(host_subject_id)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = host_subject_id, color = host_sex, fill = host_disease)) +
  geom_bar(linewidth = 1.1, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_age, 1)), stat = "count",
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3, color = "black") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("female" = "#0072B2", "male"   = "#D55E00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "crohns_disease"     = "#F4A6A6", 0.65,
    "ulcerative_colitis"     = "#A8DADC", 0.65,
    "control" = "#CDEAC0", 0.65))

```

```{r}
ibdm <- ibdm %>%
  update_mgnet(norm = zCompositions::cmultRepl(rela, method = "CZM",
                                               z.delete = F, z.warning = 1) %>%
                 vegan::decostand(method = "clr"))
```

```{r}
pca_clr <- prcomp(mgnet::norm(ibdm), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
pca_clr$x[, 1:2] %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "sample_id") %>%
  left_join(meta(ibdm, "tbl"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(host_subject_id = as.factor(host_subject_id)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = host_subject_id)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggqualpal::scale_fill_qualpal()
```

```{r}
dist_adonis <- dist(mgnet::norm(ibdm))

meta_adonis <-meta(ibdm, "tbl") %>%
    mutate(sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
           host_subject_id = factor(host_subject_id),
           host_disease = factor(host_disease),
           host_sex = factor(host_sex),
           host_age = as.numeric(host_age))

adonis_ibdm_subject <- vegan::adonis2(dist_adonis ~ host_subject_id,
                                      data = meta_adonis,
                                      permutations = 999)

adonis_clinical <- vegan::adonis2(dist_adonis ~ host_disease + host_age + host_sex,
                                data = meta_adonis,  
                                permutations = 999)

rm(dist_adonis, meta_adonis)
```

```{r}
adonis_ibdm_subject

adonis_clinical
```

```{r}
vegan:::RsquareAdj.default(
  x = adonis_ibdm_subject$R2[1],
  n = adonis_ibdm_subject$Df[3] + 1,
  m = adonis_ibdm_subject$Df[1])

vegan:::RsquareAdj.default(
  x = adonis_clinical$R2[1],
  n = adonis_clinical$Df[3] + 1,
  m = adonis_clinical$Df[1])
```

```{r}
sub_ibdm <- ibdm %>%
  mutate_meta(sample_sum = sum(rela)) %>%
  split_meta(host_subject_id) %>%
  filter_taxa((sum(rela > 0) / n()) >= .05,
              any(rela >= .01)) %>%
  mutate_meta(sample_lost = 1 - (sum(rela) / sample_sum)) %>%
  update_mgnet(norm = zCompositions::cmultRepl(rela, method = "CZM",
                                               z.delete = F, z.warning = 1) %>%
                 vegan::decostand(method = "clr"))
```

```{r}
sub_ibdm %>% pull_meta(sample_lost) %>% unlist() %>% max()
```
